name: Victoria Gardens
summary: Victoria Gardens is an expansive open-air lifestyle center in Rancho Cucamonga featuring over 150 stores and restaurants, anchored by Macy's, JCPenney, and Bass Pro Shops. The center combines premier shopping with entertainment options including AMC Theatres and cultural amenities like the Victoria Gardens Cultural Art Center.
demographics: Victoria Gardens attracts an affluent, family-oriented demographic from the Inland Empire region, with visitors typically ranging from middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area draws from Rancho Cucamonga and surrounding communities including Ontario, Upland, and Fontana, serving families with children, young professionals, and active retirees. Shoppers are drawn to the center's mix of quality retailers and dining options, with typical visitors seeking a convenient outdoor shopping experience that combines errands with leisure activities. The center benefits from its location 40 miles east of Los Angeles, capturing both local residents and regional visitors seeking an alternative to LA's congested shopping districts.
description: Victoria Gardens stands as the premier open-air lifestyle destination in the Inland Empire, located in Rancho Cucamonga just 40 miles east of Los Angeles. This expansive retail and entertainment complex features over 150 retailers and eateries, anchored by major department stores including Macy's and JCPenney, alongside the outdoor recreation powerhouse Bass Pro Shops. The center seamlessly blends shopping with cultural and community amenities, housing the Victoria Gardens Cultural Art Center and the Rancho Cucamonga Public Library, creating a true town center atmosphere. Entertainment options abound with AMC Theatres providing the latest cinema experiences, while the diverse restaurant collection offers everything from casual dining to upscale culinary experiences. The pet-friendly environment and thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces make Victoria Gardens more than just a shopping destination—it's a community gathering place where visitors can shop, dine, catch a movie, and enjoy cultural programming all in one beautifully landscaped setting.
